meta.title: +1 Speed Evolve Auras

imageCoverage.note: Each aura uses its official Roblox game-pass icon (420x420 PNG) downloaded from the Roblox thumbnails API via robloxIconAssetId.

sources.label: Roblox game passes API - +1 Speed Evolve
+1 Speed Evolve Wiki - Auras guide (system and roster cross-check)
+1 Speed Evolve Wiki - Multipliers Explained (stacking behavior)

notes: Official Roblox game-pass data confirms all twelve aura passes, their current Robux prices, sale status, and icon asset ids.
Auras and Trails share one equip slot unless the player owns the +3 Items Equip game pass (299 Robux), which lets a player equip extra items at once.
Auras are a multiplicative speed layer that stacks with trails, rebirth, group boost, and evolution base speed, but no checked source publishes a per-aura multiplier value.
effect stays "Not verified" on every row because no source gives exact per-aura speed numbers; confirm in-game.
Fan-wiki prices disagree with the official API on several auras (for example Yellow, Snow, Electric, Rainbow, Super Saiyan); the official game-pass API price is used for every row.
Sections are cost tiers because price is the only source-backed axis players can compare while per-aura effects stay unverified.
